_note: Two Vapi Function tools. Create each one in Vapi (Tools, Create Tool, Function) or POST each object under tools to https://api.vapi.ai/tool. Put your n8n Production URL for the Booking Tool webhook in server.url.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get open appointment times for one day. Call this before booking. Read back at most three times. Pass the start value of the time the caller picks to book_appointment exactly as given.

date.description: The day the caller wants, as YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book one appointment. Only call this after the caller confirms a time from check_availability. If the result says the time was taken, nothing was booked: offer the other times in the result.

start.description: Start time exactly as returned by check_availability, for example 2026-11-17T10:00:00-05:00.

phone.description: Caller's phone number if they gave a different one. Optional.

service.description: What the appointment is for. Optional.

notes.description: Anything the owner should know. Optional.
